description: This Java source file defines the AndroidTestListener class, which implements the ITestRunListener interface to handle and report Android test execution events, such as start, finish, failure, and stop, using process handlers and service message builders.

classes.name: AndroidTestListener
classes.description: A listener class for Android test run events, managing test start, finish, failure, and stop notifications, and communicating with the process handler.
